zh: 基于 TLS 1.3：语义与密码学设计直接继承。
顺序保护与非重放：与 TLS 1.3 的唯一安全差异。
epoch 与序号：记录层为数据报补上的状态。
cookie 扩展：沿用 TLS 1.3 的可达性验证。
0.5-RTT：未做 cookie 时的放大风险。
en: Built on TLS 1.3: the semantics and cryptographic design are inherited.
Order protection and non-replayability: the one stated security difference.
Epoch and sequence number: the record-layer state datagrams need.
Cookie extension: TLS 1.3 reachability check reused.
0.5-RTT: the amplification risk when no cookie exchange occurs.
